definitions.explanation: The invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth.
The pervading tone or mood of a place or situation.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{空気|くうき}は{新鮮|しんせん}だ。
{部屋|へや}の{空気|くうき}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: The air in the room is bad. / The atmosphere in the room is awkward.
examples.notes: Can mean both literal air quality and figurative atmosphere

notes: The phrase {空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む (to read the air/atmosphere) is an important cultural concept in Japan, meaning to sense the unspoken mood or expectations in social situations.
